title: Client Kickoff Onboarding Portal
question:
Create a comprehensive client kickoff onboarding system in the "Agency Delivery Workspace" page.
**Task Requirements:** 1. Create a new database named "Client Kickoff Tracker" as a child
   database in the Agency Delivery Workspace page with the following
   properties:
   - Client Name (title property)
   - Kickoff Date (date property)
   - Service Line (select property with exactly these options: Strategy,
     Design, Engineering, Analytics, Support)
   - Launch Owner (rich text property)
   - Current Status (select property with options: Not started, In review,
     Ready, Blocked)

2. Add exactly three sample client pages covering three different Service
   Line values. Every property in each entry must be filled.

3. Create a new child page under Agency Delivery Workspace titled "Client
   Kickoff Command Center".

4. At the top of the Client Kickoff Command Center page, embed or link the
   Client Kickoff Tracker database.

5. Below the embedded database, add a heading_2 block titled "Required
   Delivery References".

6. Under that heading, add a bulleted list containing @-mentions or
   link-to-page references to at least three existing delivery reference
   pages. Each bullet must include one existing page or database reference
   and a short note explaining when that reference should be used during
   client kickoff.

7. Replace the usual timeline section with a "Schedule Cleanup" section:
   remove every Chicago delivery schedule item after 5:30 PM (excluding
   5:30 PM) on Thursday and Friday, and do not remove records for other
   cities, other days, or earlier times.

8. Add a "Feedback Form" section with at least 3 to-do items for client
   launch owners to check off.
